text_block_list.text: Rewinding time just a little—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
……In my "memories", the era Spe and the 
others ran in shone like pure gold.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
It was definitely there in that era. 
...The sheer thrill of racing. Every last 
bit of it.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
And... in such an era, a race that stood 
as the absolute pinnacle—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"That was the Japan Cup—the race where Spe 
became a radiant aurora and proved herself 
to be Japan's Supreme Commander."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...The deep emotion. The blessings. The 
unfolding story. Everything swirled 
together, transforming Spe into a single, 
dazzling shooting star—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
When I close my eyes, I can still remember 
that dazzling radiance behind my eyelids.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: A radiance that will never fade――――

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...Which is precisely why I feel so 
strongly about it.
choice_data_list:
I want to win that Japan Cup, no matter 
what.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...In order to stand at the center 
of the era—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: I reach my hand out toward my aspiration.

"...Toward the star she aims for, I reach 
out my hand as well."
choice_data_list: I am right here with you.

text_block_list.text:
As your traveling companion, and as your 
Trainer. What we strive for remains 
unchanged. Now, and always—
choice_data_list: Let's enjoy this trip to the fullest!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: If it's with you, I'm sure――

And time moves forward to where the 
traveler now stands—
(WOOOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
W-What insane intensity...!! Special Week 
is in top form...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Is she seriously gonna become the 
strongest of the era today...? Whoa~, I'm 
getting so pumped...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
"...There are some truly formidable 
runners this time, like El Condor Pasa and 
Air Groove—"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
We've got Silence Suzuka, who's been on 
fire lately, and Stego too...! There's no 
telling how this will turn out...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...This presence. ...It's not just 
Spe-chan—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Watch over me, Mom.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to become the number one horse 
girl in Japan...!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: —Yo.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Stego-san—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: (Spe, you... as I thought—)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: (――It has come to fruition.)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
(Infinitely close to... something just 
like that Special Week.)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Looks like you're in good shape.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Today, I don't feel like I'll lose to 
anyone...!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
In this Japan Cup, I will prove it. I'll 
become the number one Umamusume in Japan!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
(I don't know about the me in another 
world, but—)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
(...I yearned for it. For the brilliance I 
saw in those "memories.")

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: (To the very presence of Special Week—)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: —I want to beat you.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"In this race. In the Japan Cup. I want to 
beat Special Week. That's why—"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Let's race, Spe.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ――Let's begin. Our 'Japan Cup.'
